# QR generator provenance

`qrcode-generator.mjs` is the unmodified `dist/qrcode.mjs` from
[`qrcode-generator` 2.0.4](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator),
published by Kazuhiko Arase under the MIT license. Source:
<https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator>.

The file was extracted from the published npm tarball
`https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz`.
SHA-256 of the vendored file:
`ea91d7118a5395289170da848b7c6758b996163bfbccf312591ab65a4911b7c0`.
The upstream MIT license text is in `qrcode-generator.LICENSE`.
